# UI5 TypeScript Conversion

Skills that teach agents to work with UI5 TypeScript Conversion. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [UI5/plugins-coding-agents](https://github.com/UI5/plugins-coding-agents), at commit `2b8c4a9`.

SAPUI5 / OpenUI5 plugin for coding agents.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **UI5 TypeScript Conversion**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **UI5 TypeScript Conversion**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install ui5-typescript-conversion@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skill: `ui5-typescript-conversion`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/UI5/plugins-coding-agents
